answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 245 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the ocean challenge, the jade audit can replay the gale history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 260 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
